resource.text:
{
  "id": "sync-drive",
  "name": "Sync Drive",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "apiVersion": 12,
  "entry": "plugin.js",
  "icon": "icon.png",
  "description": "Sincroniza tus aparatos de Kino a traves de un Web App de Google Apps Script tuyo, que guarda la copia cifrada en tu Google Drive. Monta Code.gs (ver README) y escribe su URL /exec y su token.",
  "author": "yumehotaru41-rgb",
  "hosts": [
    "script.google.com"
  ],
  "fetchHosts": "any",
  "capabilities": [
    "syncProvider"
  ],
  "settings": [
    {
      "key": "needs",
      "type": "help",
      "title": "Qué necesitas",
      "titleEn": "What you need",
      "body": "Dos datos de tu Web App de Google Apps Script:\n- la direccion https del Web App (la URL que termina en /exec)\n- el token que muestra setup() en Apps Script\n\nPara montarlo, sigue el README de este repositorio.",
      "bodyEn": "Two things from your Google Apps Script Web App:\n- its https address (the URL ending in /exec)\n- the token setup() prints in Apps Script\n\nTo set it up, follow this repository's README.",
      "devices": [
        "phone"
      ]
    },
    {
      "key": "guide",
      "type": "link",
      "label": "Ver la guía",
      "labelEn": "Open the guide",
      "url": "https://github.com/yumehotaru41-rgb/kino-plugin-sync-drive",
      "devices": [
        "phone"
      ]
    },
    {
      "key": "server",
      "label": "Tu servidor",
      "labelEn": "Your server",
      "type": "section",
      "hint": "La URL /exec del Web App y el token que imprimió setup() en Apps Script.",
      "hintEn": "The Web App's /exec URL and the token setup() printed in Apps Script."
    },
    {
      "key": "serverUrl",
      "label": "Dirección del Web App",
      "labelEn": "Web App address",
      "type": "text",
      "hint": "https://script.google.com/macros/s/…/exec",
      "hintEn": "https://script.google.com/macros/s/…/exec"
    },
    {
      "key": "token",
      "label": "Token",
      "labelEn": "Token",
      "type": "password",
      "hint": "El que mostró setup() en Apps Script",
      "hintEn": "The one setup() printed in Apps Script"
    },
    {
      "key": "status",
      "label": "Estado",
      "labelEn": "Status",
      "type": "status"
    },
    {
      "key": "check",
      "label": "Probar conexión",
      "labelEn": "Test the connection",
      "type": "action"
    }
  ],
  "sync": {
    "mode": "poll",
    "pullEveryMs": 300000,
    "pushDebounceMs": 60000,
    "maxBlobBytes": 4194304,
    "keySecret": "token",
    "provision": [
      "serverUrl",
      "token"
    ]
  }
}
